missions:
Things happen suddenly, and thus I write:
This is the first time the nine-tailed child will join battle.
By harnessing her unique Arts,
the enemy will never be able to touch those devices.

Do not rely on any external power.
They will only tarnish the purity of your Arts.
At the moment anger boils over,
discard the power of the devices and make your stand.

The morning mist compels the quill.
The stones of Wolumonde congregate, then disintegrate.
Until 20 Colossi are returned to the earth,
the land shall know no respite.

Beneath the Capitol Spire.
Mudrock's Sarkaz decide to act.
A tongue of flame laps at the whole town.
But in front of the gates, no more than 6 people stand guard.

At the end of it all, consciousness begins to escape from my mind.
I saw the town I once hated riddled with holes, but this brought me no joy.
The ones left behind continue their search into the wilderness, and find a new conflict.
There, I see three wandering giants.
I see our mountain.

list: A famous painting of Leithanien, though this particular one is a reproduction. True beauty lies in the imagination.
A refreshing drink popular among Leithanians. Though the primary purpose of these drinks is to refresh and reinvigorate, imbibing too much is said to cause certain side effects...
A record player placed upon a tall, Leithanian-style table. Every soul in Leithanien is nourished by this unmatched melody.
Heavy curtains thick enough to have a sound-cancellation effect. When pulled back, the city at night is fully visible beneath you.
Heavy curtains that can block the light. When pulled down, they ensure that your privacy remains undisturbed.
'The candle's light burns dimly on a silent night. The cold and hunger have finally left him. How beautiful this dream is... Goodbye, my friend.'
theme: A room that reproduces the nightlife of Leithanien. After the curtain of night falls, music rises to accompany it.

list:
You have witnessed everything.
The suspect is dead, the trail has gone cold, and the murderer has disappeared into the tempest of unrest. Only hatred remains to spring the trap, waiting for this side of Terra to fall into the net of law.
Complete all stages in [Capitol Spire] with a 3-star rating, not including stages in the Occupied Zone (excluding tutorials)

You resolved a case within a remote town in Leithanien.
Not everyone bears malice, but 'it' continues to slide deeper into the abyss.
Complete TW-8 with a 3-star rating while controlling all Gramophones at the time of victory

You took control of all 'Gramophones' and defeated the enemy leader.
The L-44 'Gramophone' is merely an industrial code and product name; the object itself actually does not have any of the functionalities of a gramophone. The rhythmic melody of a rock being struck can perhaps become a new form of music.
Complete all stages in the Occupied Area of [Capitol Spire] on Tribulation Mode

You have learned this poem.
As the only person who knows the final chapter of this old man's life experience, you have pieced together the truth after weathering trials and tribulations. Please do not forget him.
Complete TW-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while controlling all Gramophones at the time of victory

During the most perilous operation, you held onto control of the 'Gramophones.'
Perhaps you should also consider installing an Arts defense system like this?
Complete all stages in [Silent Frontier] on Challenge Mode

You have overcome more challenging missions.
Victory brings the hope of unity and survival, giving Wolumonde a path forward.

You resolved the underlying reason for the riots.
Violence is not the answer to everything - order must be achieved.
During the event, obtain Operator Folinic

A medal made by Folinic.
Not everyone is ready to come to terms with their past, nor should we ask for that.
During the event, spend 2400 Aristocrat's Antique Aureus in the 'August Fair'

You spent a lot of money in Wolumonde.
Everyone is cheering because of the revitalized economy.
Decipher any puzzle in the Antique Diary and collect the rewards

You deciphered the puzzle to reveal a part of the truth.
The old man was the king of his lofty history.
Complete all the content in 'Burnt Offerings' and collect the rewards

This town will forever remember your contributions.
This tragedy may have been unpreventable, but the outcome could have been worse.
set:
A set of engraved medals that record the circumstances revolving around the tragedy of Wolumonde.
The many cities and spires of Wolumonde may overlook their deaths, but Rhodes Island will not.
Not all violence is justified. Who is the judge of right and wrong in the eyes of a Catastrophe?
